open: Gameweek four. Deadline Saturday, seven thirty. Ten fixtures, and a Manchester derby with seventeen of this league's starters. Here's how it lines up.

Palmer tops the eleven at seven. Hull haven't conceded a league goal yet.
The Soaring Gulls. CJ leads the series four to three, and there's not a flag in the squad.
Tavernier: ten points and a Team of the Week badge last time out.
Predicted: forty-four point six to fifty-four point seven, the week's highest number.
Devils U21s. PJ is nought and three, with the week's lowest projection.
Gvardiol tops his line at seven point three, one of three City starters on Sunday.
Trophy Hunters. Bryant leads the series five to two, fresh off a season-best fifty-three.
Tarkowski projects seven. A Tarkowski clean sheet and a Solanke goal cannot both happen.
Predicted: thirty-two point three to thirty-eight point nine. Five derby shirts in this one.
The Besties Derby. I Am a Baleba: Ethan is one and two, with the lowest points-for in the league.
Haaland projects eight. Eight goals in seven league games against United.
Team Jacob. Top of the table, two wins and a draw.
Gakpo is the whole margin: nine point three, the week's highest projection, and a seventy-five percent doubt.
Predicted: fifty point four to fifty point eight. Four tenths of a point.
Kobbie Mainoo Fan. Baha has the most points in the league: one, one and one.
Isak, projected seven point seven at Anfield, off thirteen points and a Team of the Week badge.
In It to McGinn It. Nate is two and one, after beating Parker.
Bruno Fernandes projects nine. With Cherki, seventeen point three between them: nearly half of Nate's total.
Predicted: fifty-two to thirty-eight point six. Everything else on the board tilts to Baha.
